name: config-ui-agui-web
description: HIMMEL-4480 PR3: the AG-UI streamed agent view (React + @ag-ui/client), bundled with Bun into dist/. The reducer (src/reducer.ts) has no runtime imports, so its suite runs without an install.

scripts.build: bun build ./index.html --outdir dist --production && bun -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.agui-sources', JSON.stringify(fs.readdirSync('src', { recursive: true }).filter((f) => fs.statSync('src/' + f).isFile())))"
